items.title: shayanmostafaei/Omics_ADRD_Integrated_Modeling: This project combines multi-omics biological aging clocks, polygenic risk scores (PRS), and advanced machine learning techniques to predict Alzheimer's disease and related dementias (ADRD) using UK Biobank data. It includes R and Python code for data preprocessing, model construction, survival and competing risk analysis, and visualization.
items.title_zh: shayanmostafaei/Omics_ADRD_Integrated_Modeling ：该项目结合了多组学生物老化时钟、多基因风险评分（ PRS ）和先进的机器学习技术，使用英国生物库数据预测阿尔茨海默病和相关痴呆症（ ADRD ）。它包括用于数据预处理、模型构建、生存和竞争风险分析以及可视化的R和Python代码。
